description: SMART METRO [supporting dataset] is a data set deposited in ROSA P by its authors Broward County Metropolitan Planning Organization (Florida). The Broward Metropolitan Planning Organization (BMPO) will plan, design, and develop a cloud-based digital twin platform prototype to unify regional data across agency and departmental silos. The “SMART METRO” prototype leverages advanced systems integration and artificial intelligence technology to synthesize and analyze transportation, land use, demographic, and extreme weather datasets. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2025. Formats: ZIP. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC0-1.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet for this repository.
